text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp's here! ☆ Let's do our
best, Rickey!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon will be joining Copano
Rickey for
training at this year's summer
camp. She'll be a
reassuring partner to
have around.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Let's do lots and lots of training
together! Enough
that Tarumae takes
notice!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hopefully, when she sees us, she'll want
to stand
on the stage again. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey agrees, but she doesn't
look too
optimistic.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I assume she's sensing from the feng shui
that it
won't be that easy. But still...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
choice_data_list: リッキー、できるのは強くなることだけだ
リッキー、できるのは強くなることだけだよ
choice_data_list_en: Rickey, all we can do is get stronger.
Rickey, the only thing we can do is get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Inspire... Yeah, you're right. Until now...
choice_data_list: 今度はリッキーがタルマエを引っ張る番だ
今度はリッキーがタルマエを引っ張る番だよ
choice_data_list_en: This time, it's Ricky's turn to lead Tarumae.
This time, it's Ricky's turn to lead Tarumae, okay?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
She's always been the one to inspire me.
She's
been like a living goal, sprinting
off way ahead of
me. But now...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That guiding wind has stopped blowing.
Which
means, this time...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I have to be the one to push ahead! To
the place
where the qi flows best!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And I've gotta do it with enough power
to break
open a path for those behind
me!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Which means I'll need your help, Falco!
With all
your experience as an Umadol...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I just know that if I run with you, I'll gain
a deeper
understanding of running, and
of how Tarumae
feels!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! ♪ I'll do everything I can to
help. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Smart Falcon's guidance, Copano
Rickey
could go from being a rising star
on the dirt to a
superstar of the next
generation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One thing's for sure: this summer, she'll
be kicking
things into high gear.
